module_title: PVTGs, Isolated Tribes, and Constitutional Governance
introduction: This level analyzes the most vulnerable sections of tribal society (PVTGs), the isolated tribes of the Andaman & Nicobar Islands, and the specific constitutional safeguards (5th and 6th Schedules) governing tribal areas.

core_concepts.title: PVTGs (Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups)
core_concepts.description: Based on the Dhebar Commission (1973), the government identified the most underdeveloped tribes. There are '75 PVTGs' in India. Criteria: Pre-agricultural technology, stagnant/declining population, extremely low literacy, and subsistence economy. 'Odisha' has the highest number of PVTGs (13).

core_concepts.title: Tribes of Andaman & Nicobar Islands
core_concepts.description: Divided into two races: 1. Negrito (Andaman Islands): Great Andamanese, Onge, Jarawa, and Sentinelese. 2. Mongoloid (Nicobar Islands): Shompen and Nicobarese.

core_concepts.title: Specific Cultural Systems
core_concepts.description: 1. Matriarchy: Property and names pass from mother to daughter among 'Khasi' and 'Garo' tribes. 2. Polyandry: The practice of a woman having multiple husbands (usually brothers) was historically prevalent among the 'Toda' (Nilgiris) and 'Jaunsari' (Uttarakhand) tribes.

core_concepts.title: 5th and 6th Schedules
core_concepts.description: The 5th Schedule governs 'Scheduled Areas' in 10 states through Tribal Advisory Councils. The 6th Schedule provides for 'Autonomous District Councils' (ADCs) in only four Northeastern states: Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram (AM-TM).

important_entities.name: Sentinelese
important_entities.key_fact: Most Isolated Tribe in the World
important_entities.significance: Living on North Sentinel Island, they remain one of the last 'uncontacted' tribes on Earth. The Indian government follows a 'Hands-off, Eyes-on' policy, strictly forbidding any contact or proximity to protect them from modern diseases and preserve their autonomy.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Examiners often include 'Manipur' or 'Arunachal' in the 6th Schedule list to confuse you. Remember, they are NOT in the 6th Schedule. Only Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram are included.
While most Andaman tribes are isolated, the Shompen tribe (a PVTG of Great Nicobar) made news for voting for the first time in recent general elections, signaling a shift in mainstream contact.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram. Note: Both 'M' states are NOT Manipur.

exam_strategy_tips: UPSC often asks about the 'Criteria for PVTGs'. Ensure you know all four: Pre-agriculture tech, stagnant population, low literacy, and economic backwardness.
Understand the racial difference: Andaman tribes are Negrito, Nicobar tribes (Shompen) are Mongoloid.
